name: cometchat-marketing
description: CometChat marketing skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: backlink-prospector-plugin
plugins.description: Find realistic backlink prospects from keywords + competitors, score them with live Ahrefs metrics, find contacts, draft personalized outreach, and append the queue to a shared Google Sheet.

plugins.name: seo-content-reviver-plugin
plugins.description: Watch published pages for SEO decay vs each page's historical peak, diagnose the likely cause, and recommend a specific fix per page — into a Google Sheet. Recommend-only.

plugins.name: seo-pipeline-plugin
plugins.description: Carry a topic or page through the full SEO lifecycle and hand back a review-ready brief — target keywords, a SERP-derived outline, on-page checklist, internal links, and an optimized meta title + description — into a Google Sheet. Recommend-only.
